At each of the 4 re-selection points a grid neighbor may replace it (Section~\ref{sec:rh_methods_tuning}); this happened 4 times in 24 re-selections (ridge 1 and 0, lasso 1 and 0, elastic net 2 and 0, for the HAR benchmark and the full predictor set). Panel B: the best trial of an Optuna search on the pooled intraday pre-sample (24{,}000-interval window; random forest: trial 255 of 400), ranked by MSE and then held fixed for both predictor sets; (log): searched on a logarithmic scale. $n_{\min}$ was selected on 24{,}000 intervals and is rescaled to the 2{,}000-day window (rescaled value in parentheses). Implementations: LightGBM \citep{Ke2017} with bagging at every round, XGBoost \citep{Chen2016} with histogram-based split finding and the scikit-learn random forest with bootstrap samples; random seeds are fixed.
